description: This file defines a SwiftUI widget for an iOS app, specifically implementing a live activity widget using ActivityKit. It manages the display of device or activity status within the Dynamic Island, Lock Screen, and other contexts, based on the state contained in OpenClawActivityAttributes.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view for the lock screen, displaying a status dot, activity name, status text, and trailing view based on the activity state.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Returns a view representing the current activity state, showing a progress indicator, icons, or timer as appropriate.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Creates a small colored circle indicating activity status.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status dot based on activity state.
